frame: van space = Unity frame of the prefab root Van (x right, y up, z forward, metres, ground y = 0); body frame of VAN3_CONTRACT.md (x forward, y left, z up) -> (-y, z, x). Every part has an identity local rotation at rest: parent-local = van space - parent origin.
note: Interaction zones the setup builds: IV_<id> under <parent>, trigger BoxCollider (center / size in the parent frame), layer Interact, VanInteractable {id, kind, side, label, part, socket, itemType}. kind: the game's (toggle, momentary, rotary, selector, pull, lever, hinge, door, cap, lock, seat, ladder, stow) + the van's: slot (use the item in hand here: pour, plug, insert, tow, jack point, the stove, brush snow / wipe a pane), hide (crouch / lie here), item (a road wheel to take off once its nuts are off). side: in / out / both - the _In / _Out rule (interior box in model_facts.json). Parts smaller than 2 cm get a 2 cm box.
